rubric.scope: Independent synthetic final holdout for local retrieval. Documents and questions were authored before final scoring. Archive, workflow, and parallel instructions act as shared topic distractors; some use the exact nouns but describe a different condition, object, or destination.
rubric.positiveQueries: 36 natural questions, twelve each in English, Chinese, and mixed language. Each language contributes four direct, four paraphrase, and four contextual questions. The query ID encodes the sampling group.
rubric.sourcedHit: A result is relevant when its relative path is annotated as answering the specific question and exact revision readback matches the corpus bytes containing the annotated answer sentence.
rubric.denominator: Report sourced hit@1 and hit@3 against all positives, by language, and optionally by sampled style. Report empty and irrelevant responses as misses.
rubric.negativeControls: Report nine intentionally unanswerable controls separately, three per language. Six request absent facts about a topic in the corpus; three have no answering topic in the corpus.
rubric.target: Report exact readback and misses alongside measured sourced retrieval against the plan's 80 percent target.

documents.river-study/reed-watch.md:

Mark every photo with a station number. The folder for public slides has a separate format.

documents.repair-desk/cloud-meter.md:

Fold the paper instructions separately. Record the case number before closing the cabinet.

Before Cloud Meter goes back on the shelf, tie the detached lens cover to the red loop on its case.
documents.magazine-office/ink-index.md:

An unsigned Ink Index correction should be initialled on the inside of the back cover.
documents.archive-lab/orbit-card.md:

Keep the damaged sleeve with the batch records after checking its label.

If the Orbit Card sleeve splits along a side seam, transfer the card to the temporary drawer marked 待封套.
documents.reading-project/moss-page.md:

Print the ordinary page count on the cover sheet. Keep loose clips off the display table.

For Moss Page, if two proof sheets carry the same page number, keep both sheets in a clip marked 重号 and ask the editor to confirm.
documents.display-crew/pearl-panel.md:

The display cards may be moved to another holder. Set tools on the metal tray.

At a normal changeover, copy the confirmed reading on the next line and close the book.

documents.archive/desk-and-travel-slips.md:
# Desk and travel slips: training examples

For image plates staying in the workroom, the wooden box number is enough to find the plate on the inventory trolley. A paper sleeve is only issued for a plate leaving the room. The training example records the quantity of wooden boxes, not the travelling plate's identifier.

For Orbit Card, an empty spare sleeve goes into the drawer marked 库存. The inventory sheet lists undamaged envelopes only; damaged originals need a separate inspection.
documents.food-cooperative/retail-packs.md:

The oat cartons sold at the counter are grouped in open trays of six. A filled display crate usually has three open trays, but staff do not use these temporary displays as the wholesale tally.

Send borrowed wax colour charts back in padded mailers because their wooden covers may rub against one another. Wax swatches travel separately from charts. The mailroom has blank address labels beside both envelope boxes.
documents.transcription/reading-rooms.md:
# Reading room excerpt notation

In the edited dramatic readings for the public website, use three dots to show a short portion removed by the editor. A clear pause after a whole line remains a normal paragraph break. These examples were prepared from printed scripts, not from the drama tapes.

复核环境录音时，若雷声之后已经听见雨点，可把样带移到降水声栏。天际声栏的名称曾出现在旧空白表上，这一页不说明单独雷声如何归类。

Speckled beach pebbles in the loan box use dotted labels. Striped stones have separate photo stands, because they show better when the light runs across the bands. The markers are for the public exhibit rather than the survey tally.
documents.housing/visitor-and-porter-desk.md:

The guesthouse sometimes puts empty baskets on the outdoor bench before the morning rounds. The indoor porch mat belongs to the cleaning crew. This notice covers collection before breakfast, without deciding where to leave a delivered basket in bad weather.

The second arch in the residence has a narrow slot for weekend visitor forms. A parcel that fits the ledge may be collected beside the entrance at the usual time.

For the exhibition card under a biscuit tin, copy the product name from its paper wrapper. The raised metal letters are used in the display photographs. Exhibition cards and catalogue notes are prepared by different volunteers.
documents.zine-office/bundles-and-proofs.md:

Ordinary folded zines are bundled in groups of ten. The top sheet of a display bundle may be blank so visitors can add a note. The display bundles never enter the print lead's misprint count.

Moss Page 结束后把印多的封面夹到写有 多余封面 的夹子里。这条说明只对封面和完全相同的废印件适用。

If an accession label is missing or unreadable, put the unopened seed packet in the inspection tray. If an outer envelope arrives empty, return it to the stationery box. Torn labels cannot be repaired with a hand-written replacement.

queries.query: Tulip Case 少了一张 tag，要去哪袋拿替换的？

relevant.anchor: Replace any missing Tulip Case tag with one from the pouch marked 备用标签.

queries.query: Marble Script 旁边那行被画了杠，内容还能看懂，要抄到哪个 field？

relevant.anchor: Marble Script 中划掉但仍清楚的边注应保留，录在可辨删改栏。

queries.query: 拍 Reed Watch 时标杆还没立上，那张 picture 应该归到哪个文件夹？

relevant.anchor: For Reed Watch, the photograph taken before the water marker is installed goes in the folder titled 布设前.

queries.query: Cloud Meter 还回来时镜头盖散在一旁，怎么把它和 case 放在一起免得再丢？

relevant.anchor: Before Cloud Meter goes back on the shelf, tie the detached lens cover to the red loop on its case.

queries.query: Ink Index 上有人改过一处但没留名字，我补 initials 应该写在哪一面？

relevant.anchor: An unsigned Ink Index correction should be initialled on the inside of the back cover.

queries.query: Orbit Card 套子的侧边裂了，我手边没有替换套，card 先收进哪个 drawer？

relevant.anchor: If the Orbit Card sleeve splits along a side seam, transfer the card to the temporary drawer marked 待封套.

queries.query: Moss Page 两张 proof 都写了同一个页码，现阶段怎么收，能丢掉一张吗？

relevant.anchor: For Moss Page, if two proof sheets carry the same page number, keep both sheets in a clip marked 重号 and ask the editor to confirm.

queries.query: Pearl Panel 的 frame 比支架宽，新的还没到，应该先把样品搁在哪里？

relevant.anchor: If the Pearl Panel holder is too narrow for a framed sample, leave the sample on the felt mat marked 暂放 until a wider holder arrives.

queries.query: Amber Dial 的数值还在跳，可下一组已经来交接。handover book 上该怎么写？

relevant.anchor: If the Amber Dial reading has not settled when the group changes, write 待复测 in the handover book and leave the value blank.
